name: MTAC 264 143 MAX (MTAC, 143 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".564 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, printed ".289 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .264 (6.5mm), Grains 143, Minimum Required Twist *1-6.5", Part Number MTAC 264 143 MAX, G1 BC .564 (A.B.), G7 BC .289 (A.B.), OAL 1.501", Bullet Projection 1.056"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.056". The same G1 .564 and G7 .289 are printed for MTH 308 190 MAX.
